About Us

Manufacturer and wholesaler of export packaging and material handling products for container and cargo shipping since 1998.

Company Overview

28 years of packing cargo that arrives intact

Elite Industries Pvt. Ltd. was established in 1998 at Surat, Gujarat, supplying corrosion protection and load-securing materials to engineering exporters shipping out of the west-coast ports.

How we started

The company began as a strapping and stretch film converter serving a handful of machinery exporters. Repeated claims for rust and in-transit shifting pushed the business towards the two problems that damage most containerised cargo — moisture and movement. Extrusion of VCI film followed, then a wood shop for ISPM-15 treated pallets and crates, and later container desiccants and lashing systems.

Today Elite Industries runs its own extrusion, converting, slitting and timber lines with a team of 180 people, and has completed more than 2400 supply programmes for around 650 customers.

What we make

  • VCI films, bags, paper and emitters for ferrous and mixed-metal assemblies
  • ISPM-15 heat-treated pallets, cases, crates and skids
  • Steel and polyester strapping, seals, buckles and tensioning tools
  • Machine and hand stretch film, 12 to 35 micron
  • Container desiccants, dunnage bags, lashing systems and edge protection

Our mission

To get every consignment to the port of discharge in the condition it left the packing bay. That means specifying the right barrier for the metal, the right restraint for the load, and documentation the destination customs officer accepts without a query. We would rather size a job correctly than sell more material into it.

Quality standards

Quality management ISO 9001:2015 certified
Wood packaging ISPM-15 heat treatment, 56 °C core for 30 minutes, stamped and recorded
Film thickness Gauge checked every shift, ±5% tolerance on nominal micron
VCI performance Razor-blade corrosion test on every masterbatch lot before extrusion
Strapping Break load and elongation verified per coil on a calibrated tensile rig
Desiccants Gravimetric absorption check at 90% RH before dispatch
Traceability Lot number on every roll, coil, bag and pallet
Despatch documents Test reports and ISPM-15 treatment records travel with the consignment
Our Ideology

Packaging is a load calculation, not a wrapper

A container crossing the equator sees 40 °C temperature swings, condensation on the roof panels and continuous vibration for four to six weeks. These are the working principles we apply to every specification we write.

Specify for the voyage

Barrier grade, desiccant quantity and lashing capacity are calculated from the metal, the net weight, the route and the transit time — not copied from the last order.

Make it ourselves

Extrusion, converting, slitting and timber treatment run in-house. Controlling the line is the only reliable way to hold film gauge, VCI dosing and treatment records.

Test before it ships

Corrosion, tensile, absorption and gauge checks are run on our own samples and recorded against the lot. A test figure is worth more than a claim.

Clear customs cleanly

Wood packaging is heat treated and marked to ISPM-15 so consignments are not held, re-treated or turned back at the destination port.

Hold the schedule

Buffer stock on fast-moving films, strapping and desiccants, so a packing bay is never idle waiting on consumables ahead of a vessel cut-off.

Train the packing bay

Our engineers work on the floor with the packing team on sealing, tension settings and lashing patterns. Good material applied badly still ends in a claim.

Achievements

What we have built since 1998

Growth has followed capability — each step brought in a process we had previously been buying from someone else.

  • 1998

    Founded at Surat, Gujarat as a converter of stretch film and strapping for local machinery exporters.

  • 2003

    First blown-film extrusion line commissioned, bringing VCI film production in-house instead of buying converted stock.

  • 2007

    Timber shop and heat-treatment chamber added; registered for ISPM-15 treatment and marking of pallets, cases and crates.

  • 2011

    Quality management system certified to ISO 9001, covering extrusion, converting, timber treatment and despatch.

  • 2015

    In-house test laboratory set up for razor-blade corrosion testing, tensile break-load checks and gravimetric desiccant absorption.

  • 2018

    Container desiccants and dunnage bags added to the range; first direct shipments to buyers in the Gulf and South East Asia.

  • 2021

    Second extrusion line and automatic slitting installed, taking VCI and stretch film capacity past 300 tonnes a month.

  • 2024

    Lashing and load-securing range introduced — web lashings, edge protection and container fittings — alongside on-site packing surveys.

  • 2026

    180 people across manufacturing, testing and despatch, with more than 2400 supply programmes completed for around 650 customers.

Certifications

What we hold, and what it covers

ISO 9001:2015

Quality management system certified across extrusion, converting, timber treatment, testing and despatch, with annual surveillance audits.

ISPM-15 registered

Registered facility for heat treatment and marking of solid wood packaging — 56 °C core temperature held for 30 minutes, with treatment records issued per consignment.

In-house test laboratory

Corrosion, tensile, gauge and humidity testing run on our own lots, so each despatch leaves with figures against it rather than a generic datasheet.

Send us the packing list

Give us the metal, the net weight, the route and the transit time, and we will specify the barrier, restraint and desiccant quantity for the job.
